levels.title: Threshold
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: Safe / Secure / Unconfirmed Entities (no numeric class)
levels.summary: Yellow office-like maze: sickly yellow wallpaper, damp seamless Berber-style carpet, buzzing fluorescent lights. Nicknamed 'The Yellow Hell'.
levels.scale_topology: Infinite indoor labyrinth of rooms, hallways and stairs; layout shifts when unobserved.
levels.lighting_sound: Buzzing fluorescent lights with random loud spikes; blackout zones are unlit and silent; whispers, voices, scratching behind walls.
levels.entity_policy: NO CONFIRMED ENTITY PER SOURCE (existence unknown; only reported dark figures and unexplained sounds)
levels.signature_mechanic: Peripheral Shift: unobserved layout warps or rearranges, erasing mapped progress; stable arch zones; Isolation Effect with no companions.

levels.title: Habitable Zone
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: Safe and Secure. (header list: 'Safe and Secure', 'Presence of Anomalous Resources', third item unresolved template)
levels.summary: Endless non-Euclidean halls like a cross between an underground parking lot and an abandoned warehouse (grey concrete, pillars, pipes), plus a labyrinth of dim concrete corridors with purposeless rooms.
levels.scale_topology: Huge indoor level, partitioned into sectors (Aquila, Gild, Gothic, Ouroboros, Garden, Fabled); halls non-Euclidean, corridors Euclidean for kilometres.
levels.lighting_sound: Artificial overhead lights with random total-blackout Flickering; pipes clang and rumble; corridors dim and quiet. No sun; time not meaningful (narrative).
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Arms, Clumps, Crawlers, Dullers, Growlers, Hounds, Nguithr'xurh, Skin-Stealer, Smilers, Wrangler, Wretches; Ouroboros construction creatures; entities rarely wander in the corridors
levels.signature_mechanic: Non-Euclidean hall of crates and pillars with random total-blackout Flickering; retreat to Euclidean corridor rooms; landmark navigation; crates that vanish when unobserved; sector variants.

levels.title: Abandoned Utility Halls
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Infinite Euclidean maze of cramped chalky concrete maintenance tunnels turning at 45 degrees, lined with non-cooperating pipes and machinery and many coded doors.
levels.scale_topology: Infinite indoor tunnel array; side rooms and void rooms behind doors; Office Space EL3A inside it.
levels.lighting_sound: Sparse buzzing fluorescents (white or orange), uneven; machines only whir; violet emergency lights in blackout areas.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Windows, Smilers, Deathmoths, Clumps, Jerry, Hounds, Facelings, Wretches, Nguithr'xurhs, Death Rats, Cannibal Cuisines, Wranglers, Photoshop, Growlers (Skin-Stealers left)
levels.signature_mechanic: Cramped 45-degree machine tunnels with series-wired lights (a break blacks out a 3x3-6x6 grid) and colour/material-coded doors to many levels, plus lightless infinite void rooms.

levels.title: Electrical Station
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Old electrical facility of brick-walled hallways, dusty concrete floors and dim fluorescent lights, with wiring, machinery and black-liquid pipes on the walls; contains special rooms and a large M.E.G. base.
levels.scale_topology: Indoor maze of inconsistently sized halls; size unknown because indestructible bars block most of it; largest area several miles wide with a ceiling hundreds of feet tall.
levels.lighting_sound: Dim fluorescent lights; faint Level 0 hum plus whirring, buzzing, crackling electricity and liquid rushing in pipes; temperature 18-33 C.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Hounds, Facelings, Wretches, Deathmoths, Skin-Stealers, Smilers, Clumps, Death Rats (organised brigades); Entity 71 one-off; Empresses and shadow figure only as reports
levels.signature_mechanic: Bar-gated brick electrical maze with an entity-free Sanctum refuge and a fortress base; hostile entities act as coordinated brigades; paranoia hotspots in dark narrow halls.

levels.title: Abandoned Office
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Empty office building, almost no furniture; most windows blacked out; Almond Water coolers, vending machines and fountains scattered.
levels.scale_topology: Not stated (no size or topology given); indoor office; stairways and elevators serve as exits.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Hounds, Dullers (observed, no behaviour); Smiler unverified claim
levels.signature_mechanic: Safe, supply-rich empty office where Almond Water is plentiful; blacked-out windows with rare trap windows; exits (stairs/elevators) can vanish out of line of sight.

levels.title: Terror Hotel
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Infinite 1930s-style hotel complex with 1920s furniture; mahogany/gold wallpaper, wood/marble/carpet floors, self-cleaning surfaces, random smooth jazz. Three accessible areas: Main Hall, Beverly Room, Boiler Room.
levels.scale_topology: Infinite indoor hotel; three linked areas; elevators lead to floors 1-382 but 1-12 only move within the level.
levels.lighting_sound: Antique candle holders, some electric lamps that buzz like Level 0; quiet jazz, party chatter behind walls, boiler machinery and dripping.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Deathmoths (swarms), plus listed Hounds, Woodlins, Skin-Stealers, Watchers, Nguithr'xurh, Growlers, Deathrats; Entity 26, Entity 89, Wrangler as reports
levels.signature_mechanic: Infinite hotel with floor-numbered elevators: floors 1-12 relocate within the level, 13+ means death/disappearance; Beverly Room hub with many doors leading mostly to Main Hall, sometimes Boiler Room.

levels.title: Lights Out
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Total darkness and silence in seemingly endless tight hallways of smooth cold material, likely concrete; light sources do not function.
levels.scale_topology: Seemingly endless indoor hallway series; structure barely known; stairwell down to Level 7.
levels.lighting_sound: No light at all; eerily silent like a soundproof room; faint waves near the Level 7 stairwell.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Permanent darkness where flashlights fail, near-silence, navigation by touch, rising dread with time; a wrong turn may seal exits.
content_warnings: injury testimony (missing eye, broken leg, clawing)

levels.title: Thalassophobia
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: An impossibly large dark ocean under a high concrete ceiling, reached via a furnished carpeted entrance room built sideways into the ceiling.
levels.scale_topology: Apparently infinite ocean room; entrance door ~4.5 m above water; depth zones to beyond 7 km; carpeted floor inferred; a few rock islands.
levels.lighting_sound: Dim natural light at surface, Twilight darker/colder, Midnight completely dark; bubbling from below in the Abyss; sound not otherwise stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Thing On Level 7, Tiny; no other life
levels.signature_mechanic: Gravity-flipped doorway drops you into a lightless depth-zoned ocean where breath lasts long but two entities rule fixed zones.

levels.title: Cave Systems
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 4; Exit: 4/5 Very Difficult to Exit; Environment: 4/5 Extreme Environmental Risk; Entities: 4/5 Extreme Hostile Presence
levels.summary: Sprawling subterranean network of organic karst caves, cold and dark, with almond water pools and rivers, stalagspikes, non-Euclidean connectivity and shifting gravity. M.E.G. marked 9th Road crosses islands of stability.
levels.scale_topology: Very large underground network (Handyland alone spans acres); loops and non-linear connections; vertical shafts; fully enclosed.
levels.lighting_sound: Dark; lamps shine dimmer and sounds echo louder than expected; chittering; bioluminescent fungi, red moss, light guides, faint aurora in Handyland.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: wranglers, arachnids, hands of tar, light guides, death rats, deathmoths, scits, dunks, curabitur birds, nguithr'xhurs, smilers, camo crawlers, wretches; some areas empty
levels.signature_mechanic: Non-Euclidean caves with per-cavern gravity shifts, flash flooding and accelerated entropy, navigated by M.E.G. road markers that decay unless maintained.

levels.title: The Suburbs
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Infinite suburban area at midnight: wet unpainted asphalt streets, stone sidewalks, furnished but unpowered houses, dead trees, mostly dead street lamps, intermittent fog.
levels.scale_topology: Infinite flat outdoor suburb; grass fields at walkway edges lead to other levels; house interiors and back yards.
levels.lighting_sound: Midnight darkness like Level 6 but milder; street lamps usually off; fog. Sound not stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Mangled (fog), Neighborhood Watch, Observer, plus listed common entities
levels.signature_mechanic: Endless unpowered midnight suburb; fog spawns The Mangled; houses are furnished but dead; many random-roll exits (house door to 53, powerlines to 113) and sign-following walk to Level 11.

levels.title: Bumper Crop
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 1; Exit 2/5 Somewhat Difficult to Exit; Environment 1/5 Low Environmental Risk; Entities 0/5 No Hostile Entities
levels.summary: Endless pasture of wheat and barley fields divided into plots by tree and shrub lines, under a permanently overcast sky, with lakes, barns, sheds and dirt tracks.
levels.scale_topology: Infinite outdoor plain, flat; soil only one metre deep above a mass of worms; lakes below one consistent elevation.
levels.lighting_sound: Overcast leaden sky, constant daylight, rare light rain and fog; wind gusts among crops.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: soil worms
levels.signature_mechanic: Calm endless farmland whose only danger is digging below a 1 m soil crust into a worm mass; unused vehicle tracks lead onward.

levels.title: The City That Never Sleeps
levels.cite_authors: Greggita Mahayfaio, inspired by the original Level 11 by nerdykiddo4884
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: Safe . / Unsecure . / Low Entity Count . (three bullet lines; no numeric class stated)
levels.summary: Vast empty Western-style metropolis: block roads, skyscraper to low-rise districts, parks, subways, canals; indestructible bland buildings; unofficial hub of the Backrooms.
levels.scale_topology: Effectively unbounded outdoor city with infinite subways; skyscrapers and underground; page gives population ~129,500.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated: no light level, time of day or ambient sound described. Buildings have working lighting inside.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Facelings, Hounds, Lucky Cranes, Living Pizzas (visitors); low entity count
levels.signature_mechanic: A fluid, mostly-empty hub city whose unobserved props change and whose building types are one-way doors to other levels; a pacifying 'Level 11 Effect' keeps entities mild.
content_warnings: entity killing mentioned (U.E.C. kill entities on sight, incl. a young Faceling)
one entity-caused death quoted (Hoy Léi, M.E.G. explorer)

levels.title: Matrix
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A small brightly lit white-painted room with only a table, a chair and an adjacent locked door; per an expedition log it extends into an infinite white abyss with decaying furniture and copycat doors. It censors recordings.
levels.scale_topology: Single small room plus (per testimony) an infinite white expanse; indoor/abstract.
levels.lighting_sound: Bright white light; sound not stated.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Self-censoring bright white room with an exit ritual: sit about 15 minutes, try the locked door, pass a copycat door, wait exactly one hour, retry the door.

levels.title: The Boiling Frogs
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Infinite-or-looping 20th-century-style apartment complex of 290 floors; bland beige halls, identical flats, regenerating basic food.
levels.scale_topology: 290 floors; width and length infinite or looping; stable area geometry, unstable perimeter; indoor, vertical via stairs/elevators.
levels.lighting_sound: Dimly lit hallways; sound not stated.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Comfortable monotony: regenerating basic supplies make staying easy; lethargy and attachment gradually trap residents, who may vanish after a decade.

levels.title: Paradise
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A night forest oasis with crashing waterfalls, crimson dew-wet grass and an eternally starlit sky, narrated in second person as a lure; guests lie in the soil with glistening bones.
levels.scale_topology: Not stated; described as a forest basin. No measurements or structures given.
levels.lighting_sound: Starlit night with moonlight; waterfalls, whispering forest, cacophony, beautiful howling.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: A lovely night forest that coaxes the visitor to surrender and stay; the page withholds entrance and exit.

levels.title: Attic Floorboards
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Dank, dilapidated attic spaces packed with boxes and vintage furniture; some floorboards glow warm orange from beneath (the Orange Glow).
levels.scale_topology: Indoor, randomly shaped attic rooms; extent not stated, with presumed perimeters that blur and decay.
levels.lighting_sound: Final write-up gives no lighting; drafts report no natural light and a faint glow of unknown origin; no sound described.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Orange Glow under floorboards comforts and rewrites memories while box items decay once removed; exits are non-glowing boards, broken doors, devices, and perimeter.

levels.title: Sublimity
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Submerged ceramic-tile complex of pools and halls; lukewarm blue-green water with constant ripple; irregular lights and dark corners.
levels.scale_topology: Immense; whether infinite is not stated; indoor-pool architecture; stairs descend into deep pits.
levels.lighting_sound: Light from irregular angles with dark areas; sound muffled, dry, water sound variable.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Relaxing Epsom-salt water and altered acoustics in an empty pristine tile maze; exits by immersion or dark tunnels.

levels.title: The Courtyard of Windows
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 5 (Exit 5/5 Dead End; Environment 4/5 Extreme Environmental Risk; Entities 5/5 Hostile Infestation)
levels.summary: A cold, silent white-concrete indoor atrium ringed by evenly spaced windows infested with window entities, with a central pentagonal path, hollow birchwood circle, table, gramophone and clock.
levels.scale_topology: Irregular atrium ~45 m wide and ~30 m high; unstable white corridors on several floors reached by mahogany doors; walkways above.
levels.lighting_sound: Corridors harshly lit white; atrium silent; gramophone music in logs; 13.8 C and 45.2% humidity constant.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: window entities, pink dress facelings, skin-stealers, shadow silhouettes
levels.signature_mechanic: A trap atrium whose entry window vanishes and whose fixtures and windows shift while the player resists neuro-agent objects in near silence.

levels.title: Futuristic Halls
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Futuristic hallways of white/gray concrete with white steel beams, arabesque inscriptions and large lights; machine rooms, labs, dorms, kitchens, control rooms; many desiccated lab-coated corpses.
levels.scale_topology: Indoor, thought infinite; at least 6,080 km2 verified; single-storey complex of halls and rooms.
levels.lighting_sound: Eerie glow from large lights; some areas fully dark; distant engine noise.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE (only Hound corpses)
levels.signature_mechanic: Exploring a huge abandoned machine complex with no way out except a glowing doorframe onto starry void; lore via terminals and corpses.

levels.title: Altered Topography
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Terrain-shifting level documented as two archived states: a low-gravity foggy rainforest at permanent dawn, and an arctic glacier field with luminous reflective ice and a 13-hour day.
levels.scale_topology: Outdoor; extent not stated. Terrain alters itself at unknown intervals; exit position moves each time, destination fixed.
levels.lighting_sound: Rainforest: persistent fog, always dawn, 21C. Arctic: luminous reflective ice, about 13 h day-night cycle, 10C to 6C. Sound not stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Light Guides (arctic state); NO ENTITY PER SOURCE for the rainforest state
levels.signature_mechanic: Two terrain states (rainforest/arctic) swap at unknown intervals preceded by orbs; the only exit always leads to Level 46 but moves to a different prop (sand-covered tree or sand-covered ice).

levels.title: The Carrier
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Plane #17 resembles an early-to-mid-twentieth-century naval vessel interior: 217 identical athwartship passages with bulkhead doors and 42 compartments each.
levels.scale_topology: Finite indoor vessel of 217 sectors; passages in series by distance from the entrance; no deck structure stated.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated generally; Sector 217 machine blue light, high-pitched tone and knocking; Sectors 200-206 cold.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: unnamed human occupants incl. Sector 12 officer and skinless man
levels.signature_mechanic: A linear sequence of 217 bulkhead-separated passages entered through one closet, each sector offering a single documented anomaly.
content_warnings: corpses (infirmary with innumerable adult male corpses)
body horror (humans fused to bulkhead, skinless man)
infants (216 living human infants on the bridge)

levels.title: Memories

levels.survival_class: not stated (class bullets are unfilled template placeholders)
levels.summary: A level that appears as a childhood memory (age 2-5) of the wanderer, commonly a preschool or daycare, with whispering voices and a guide plushie.
levels.scale_topology: Not stated; room-scale memory spaces implied; void for those with no memories.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated; whispering voices are the only sound.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: The Plush Dino
levels.signature_mechanic: A personalised childhood-memory space whispering your regrets, kind to visitors and guided by a sentient plush dinosaur.

levels.title: Boreas Structure
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Fun Zone activity palace: office-like Waiting halls (white concrete, brown carpet, vending and Almond Water) and the neon black Electric with game rooms; windows show a starry void.
levels.scale_topology: Unknown extent; indoor halls; the Electric slopes imperceptibly downward; M.E.G. log claims it is a structure on a planet.
levels.lighting_sound: Neon lighting in the Electric; hallucinated breathing and heavy winds; no other audio stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Deathmoths, Clumps, Hounds, Facelings, Skin-Stealers, Nguithr'xurhs, Growlers, Wrangler, Liquid Pain; sky entity testimony only
levels.signature_mechanic: Game doors in the Electric: win for supplies, lose for hostile manifestations or dangerous teleports; temperature falls as the halls slowly descend.

levels.title: Ruins Left Behind
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: Collapsed multi-storey car park, formerly the micronation Emstable; rubble, girders, rusted car husks, abandoned tents with corpses, deep mining holes.
levels.scale_topology: Described as an infinite car park; indoor multi-floor with stratified floors (census to Floor 28); large parts inaccessible after collapse.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Ruined stacked car-park decks riddled with deep mining shafts; unstable rubble causes injury; collapse holes are the working exits; abandoned tents hold corpses and readable diary/census notes.

levels.title: The Petrified Garden
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A planetoid-sized tree superorganism with dark dense surface forest, tunnel-cavern glow rooms lit by Sorries, ancient ruins, and a hollow core with Green Giants and a water heart.
levels.scale_topology: Planetoid, surface area about Ceres; indoor-like caverns and tunnels, surface forest, hollow core; Green Giants up to 3.2 km.
levels.lighting_sound: Surface dim and dense; glow rooms bioluminescent multicolour, damp cool; Sorries whisper 'sorry...'; sentries scream like rusty chainsaws.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Gardener's Sorries, Volpes, Hounds, Clumps, Smilers, Death Rats, Deathmoths, Curabitur Birds, Wranglers, buried sentries
levels.signature_mechanic: A living planet of trees with glow-room caverns and a water-heart core; speaking a forbidden phrase wakes buried screaming sentries.
content_warnings: screams loud enough to burst eardrums (Buried Sentries)

levels.title: The Moon
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A plastic scale model of the Frontrooms solar system; only the Moon is accessible, covered in ~30 m of grey lead paint, under standard gravity.
levels.scale_topology: 1:1 solar system model, Moon surface ~38 million km2; outdoors, with B.N.T.G. mines at PlasticWorks and Bluehole; surroundings possibly a Victorian-style study.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated (no ambient light/sound description); Beauford vocalisations are heard and felt.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Moon Mites, Beauford
levels.signature_mechanic: Weather from Beauford: approach produces toxic mist or dust sandstorm; the only known way out is PlasticWorks.

levels.title: The Quarter Hub
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A long-abandoned, ransacked video game arcade of echoey rooms with maroon walls, dust and wrecked 1980s-style cabinets; rare working cabinets teleport to other levels.
levels.scale_topology: Finite indoor rooms and hallways, about 8.5 mi north-south by 9.2 mi east-west (article); notes say 8-10 miles.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated for light; rooms are echoey; dripping water from pipes (notes).
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Quarter-operated arcade cabinets, about 1 in 1500 working, each tethered to a predetermined level with a return cabinet within about 100 ft.

levels.title: The SS Fun =)
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: not stated (tags: Unsafe. Unsecure. Entity Infestation.)
levels.summary: The Frontrooms cruise ship Adventure (~150 m x 18 m), renamed SS Fun =), trashed by Partygoers; exterior decks follow normal reality, lower decks are infinite party-room labyrinths.
levels.scale_topology: Ship exterior finite (top, upper, main decks); interior lower decks infinite from an elevator hub; the ship itself relocates between levels.
levels.lighting_sound: Party decor and dark corners; screams echo down corridors; green fog on departure. Other sound not stated.
levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Partygoers, Carnivorous Balloons; testimony-only monster/Facelings
levels.signature_mechanic: A ship that vanishes in green fog and whose lower decks are an infinite party-room maze reached by elevator; poster items no-clip you in or out.

levels.title: The Bunker Springs
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.summary: A tiny limestone cave hot spring (about 18.6 m2) with two waterfalls; warm potable mineral water; no life of any kind.
levels.scale_topology: Finite, one small indoor cave; the page says it is the only part of the level left.
levels.lighting_sound: Not stated; humid air, waterfalls implied by two small waterfalls feeding the pool.
levels.entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE
levels.signature_mechanic: Safe warm spring with bathing timer (benefits after 1 h, nausea after 2 h); hidden twist exit via the second waterfall into a Stormstone wasteland.

levels.summary: Windswept blue-lit grasslands under a perpetually overcast sky, centred on the ruined medieval Stormstone Keep, ringed by mountains where a tar-like Living Abyss advances.
levels.scale_topology: Finite outdoor plain; safe zone ~13.5 km across; Stormstone Circle 1.6 km from keep; Abyss in surrounding mountains.
levels.lighting_sound: No sun or moon; faint blue glow outdoors; keep interior normally lit; lightning exactly hourly (local clocks); never rains.

levels.summary: A large island civilisation ringed by cliffs and mountains in a vast hazardous ocean; wooden towns, farms, a central trade hub (Hyperia), unique red-trunk white-leaf trees.

levels.entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: the Kraken offshore; unnamed ocean entities as reports; no land entities named

levels.title: Timeless Airport
levels.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 (text, per page licence box); media credits listed per page
levels.survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 1 (Exit: 1/5 Easy to Exit; Environment: 2/5 Some Environmental Risk; Entities: 0/5 No Hostile Entities)
